_comment: Doc Part 6.2 as data: guarded variable -> functions allowed to write it. Enforcement is by WRITING FUNCTION (Nav/Base/Logic/Bot are one object). Roles map legacy and Echolon class names. 'clear' writers may only assign a reset value (false, '', None, 0). Calls to Mut-owned mutators (RegisterBot, UnregisterBot, MoveSquadMembers...) are calls, not writes, and are never flagged.

FollowStatus.rule: Hub reads this; only Locomotion writes it (Nav:190).

FollowLeaderCtrl.rule: Set only by FollowStart, commanded by the hub (Nav:198).

writers.note: FollowStart's only helper (Nav:200, Nav:214); found by the auditor, doc 6.2 omits it

FollowSlotIndex.rule: Slot assigned by the Mut roster hook through FollowSetSlot only (Nav:223, Mut:511).

FollowSlotCount.rule: Slot assigned by the Mut roster hook through FollowSetSlot only (Nav:223, Mut:511).

FollowExitState.rule: Hub intent mailbox: written by the hub-side overrides FollowNotifyHub / FollowCheckExit only; locomotion never sets its own exit.

bFollowExitPending.rule: Hub sets it (FollowNotifyHub Base:1309, FollowCheckExit Logic:849/865). Locomotion only clears it when consuming or resetting (resolved from source: Nav:254 FollowResetEpisode, Nav:1308 FollowingLeader.EndState, Nav:1440 FollowingLeaderBasic label code).

SquadOrders.rule: Mut functions only; bots read through Mut getters.

Fireteams.rule: Mut functions only; bots read through Mut getters.

ActiveBots.rule: Mut functions only; bots read through Mut getters.

WdLastMoveIntentTime.rule: Hub stamp written by PickCombatStyle (Base:2131); readers only.

writers.note: state entry is a fresh move intent (Base:2563-2564); found by the auditor, doc 6.2 omits it

WdLastMoveIntentTime.status: [UNVERIFIED] clear writers: the doc lists only PickCombatStyle; resets elsewhere are allowed as clears

NextShoppingTime.rule: Hub-owned timer (Base:150): GoShopping state (Bot:1641, Bot:1683) and the resets (Base:541, Mut:2114).
NextShoppingTime.status: [UNVERIFIED] Base/Mut writers are whole-class: the doc names only the reset sites

bEnableAdvancedLocomotion.rule: Config only (Nav:58, default Nav:1496); never assigned in code.

unguarded.WdLastHubContactTime: Multi-writer stamp by design (Mut:340, Mut:1939, Logic:852, Logic:868); last write wins. Not enforced.
